answer: Each paid work slot is a berth at the wharf, and docking costs a 50 POA deposit locked for 20 epochs. An audit thread samples each slot output; fake or duplicated work burns the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, while one slot pays about 30 POA, so fakes lose money. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps it, and earns fees. Trust grows like a glacier, so new identities start with zero history and low-value berths.
